neighbours.label: the first syllable of a Korean or Chinese given name, right after the surname (김|경승, 박|창열, 李|秀安)
fire: 我们见到了张晓明老师。
记者张秀英报道了这个消息。
昨天李晓东先生来到了北京。
quiet: 昨天这位先生来到了北京。

short: given name after an East Asian surname
notes: Card: '영' x4, '경' x3, '정' x2, '秀' x2, '晓' x2, '상'. Probe: '창' 1.005; '강' 0.867; '경' 0.832 after 김, but the same '경' in 경기도 0.018; '秀' 0.816; ' Jong' after 'Kim' 0.339; sentences without a name at most 0.010.
